title: GameSnapshot
description: A published immutable snapshot of game state.

BodyId.description: Unique identifier for a celestial body (e.g. `planet_haven`).

BottleneckTracker.description: Rolling-window bottleneck tracker for a station/resource pair.

Buffer.description: A single resource buffer with thresholds.

BufferConfiguration.description: Buffer configuration for a station's input, output, or fuel buffer.

BuildOrder.description: A build order (ship, station, upgrade, or demolition).

BuildOrderId.description: Unique identifier for a build order.

BuildTarget.description: What a build order is constructing.

CelestialBody.description: A celestial body (planet, moon, or asteroid belt).

CommandRecord.description: A record of a committed command in the game timeline.

CommandRejection.description: Structured rejection information for a failed command.

CommandResult.description: Result payload produced by an accepted or applied command.

DestinationRef.description: A destination for ship travel or logistics.

ErrorDetail.description:
Typed error detail values.

Per GDD 13, `ErrorDetail` can be a string, bool, integer, null, or
arrays of strings or integers.

GameLifecycle.description: Lifecycle states of the game session.

oneOf.description: No game is loaded; actor has no mutable state.
A load or new-game operation is in progress; state is not yet available.
Game is loaded but paused; commands and batch ticks are accepted.
Game is running with real-time scheduler ticks; commands and pause are accepted.
A batch of ticks is being advanced; no commands or scheduler ticks are accepted.
Gate victory has been achieved; no further mutation is possible.

GameState.description: The complete simulation state at a point in time.

GateBuild.description: The Space Gate build state during assembly.

IdCounters.description: Monotonically increasing ID counters per entity kind.

InventoryDestinationRef.description: A destination for cargo delivery (inventory transfers).

LaneId.description: Orbital lane identifiers in increasing orbital radius order.

MiningTarget.description: A mining target attached to a station slot.

ProductionSlot.description: State of a single production slot.

RNGState.description: The xoshiro256** PRNG state (all-zero is invalid).

RationalRemainder.description: Rational remainder for accumulator-based resource consumption.

ReplayableGameCommand.description:
Replayable game commands that enter the command log.

This is the ADR-0003 `Command` union excluding `NewGame`, `LoadAutosave`,
`SaveNow`, `Pause`, `Resume`, and `AdvanceTicks`.

ResearchPauseReason.description: Reason a research project was paused.

ResearchProject.description: A research project tracking progress toward a technology.

Reservation.description: A logistics reservation for cargo transport.

ReservationId.description: Unique identifier for a logistics reservation.

ResourceDeposit.description: A resource deposit on a celestial body.

ResourceType.description:
The 25 resource types in canonical order (raw, refined, component).

Serialized as a camelCase string (e.g. `"metalOre"`).  This enum's
`Ord` follows the GDD 14 resource catalog order so that sparse maps
iterate deterministically.

SalvageCache.description: A durable salvage cache holding recovered materials.

SalvageId.description: Unique identifier for a salvage cache.

Ship.description: A ship entity in the simulation.

ShipJob.description: The job a ship is performing.

Station.description: A station entity in the simulation.

SurveyOrder.description: A survey order for a celestial body.

SurveyOrderId.description: Unique identifier for a survey order.

SystemPosition.description: A position within the system: lane, orbital radius, and angle.

TravelPlan.description: A ship's full travel plan from origin to destination.

TravelSegment.description: One segment of a ship's travel plan.

TravelSegmentKind.description: Kind of a single travel segment.
